lina: Quick sync  'Inference Launch' webinar next Thu 6/1 11am PT. Need owner for: registration page, Zoom config, recording backups, edit/clip owners, and lead routing. Short checklist only.
chris: I'll do reg page + GA tracking. We'll use a single-column layout. CTA: 'Reserve your seat'. Include field: role, company, email, opt-in boolean.
tariq: Zoom ops: co-hosts (lina+tariq), auto-record cloud, enable live transcription, start 15m early. Also set up RTMP fallback and local OBS backup.
nana: I'll own emails and replay cadence: instant confirmation, 24h reminder, 1h reminder, 72h replay + slides, 10-day nurture. We'll gate slides 72h.
nina: For clips I can take 3x 60s cuts. Need SRT and key timestamps.
nina: Also confirm who will moderate Q&A. Lina?
lina: Yes I'll moderate Q&A. Timeline: reg live by Mon, promo starts Tue, rehearsal Wed. Post raw recordings to Drive.
zoom-bot: reminder: hosts must enable live transcript during meeting to capture VTT.
chris: MQL rules? role contains engineer OR company_size>50 OR viewed>50% of replay. Route MQL-> SDR.
nana: Draft confirmation copy: "Thanks for registering  We'll send calendar invite and reminders." I'll post copy in channel later.
tariq: Pro tip: presenters on wired ethernet, use headset, close unnecessary apps. OBS backup on local SSD.
lina: Good. Everyone confirm by EOD.
